comment: GitHub #147, Kiln clients: player_ui's locked prompt (C 0x2b8430) counts the lock's item with the same InventoryItemCount and marks the prompt locked when it is short (G38UiPlayData +0x2c98 item, +0x2c9c amount, +0x2ca4 locked). locks/client.UiLockCountRet is that call's return address. Client-only UI code: the dedicated server has no player_ui update. The HUD draws the prompt's requirement line ("Required: Lockpick") from +0x2c98/+0x2c9c with its own count of the item in the local player's bag and colours it by that count alone (C 0xbf73a2-0xbf73e6, GitHub #147 follow-up, 31.15): locks/client.LockRowCount is right after that count. Client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1) only. docs/re/locks.md.

locks/client.UiLockCountRet.comment: mov ebx,[rdi+requiredItem]; test; cmp byte [rax],0 (DynamicInteractionLock.destroy); [rsp+0x28] = item; call InventoryItemCount; mov [rsi+0x2c98],ebx; movzx eax,word [rdi+requiredItemAmount]. The return address; kiln-items' mid hook there reads rbp+0x620 (count +0x628) and rdi, which the literal bytes pin. Client 26430625 0x2bc483

locks/client.LockRowCount.comment: The HUD's requirement row of the looked-at lock (C 0xbf5d80, the prompt draw): call the local player's UI inventory mirror (C 0xd40fe0); mov r11d,[r14+0xd8] (the item, player_ui's +0x2c98 with r14 = +0x2bc0); mov r8d,edi (0); the loop over its slot list adds each stack of the item to r8d; then movzx ecx,word [r14+0xdc] (the amount, +0x2c9c), ecx = max(amount, 1), the row's count = r8d and met = r8d >= ecx (setae; the row draw C 0xbf1ea0 colours the line by it). The address of that movzx; kiln-items' mid hook there raises r8d from the server's lock snapshot when the bag is short. Client 26430625 0xbf73be
